literal_meaning: খোলাখুলি বলা বা উন্মোচন করে বলা
figurative_meaning_en: To speak the truth; without concealing anything
similar_in_english: To lay one's cards on the table
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে সবকিছু খুলে বলল না, কিছু লুকিয়ে রাখল।
example_sentences_in_english: Just tell me openly what happened.
She didn't come clean about everything and hid some details.
note: This idiom emphasizes straightforward communication, a valued trait in Bengali social interactions.
